stories.title: Enzo Amore comments on AEW locker room and Maven interview
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Enzo Amore recently criticized AEW's locker room culture during a resurfaced interview with Maven Huffman, blasting the promotion for letting backstage altercations leak publicly. Amore contrasted this with his time in WWE, where he claimed physical fights and management discussions were kept strictly private. Following the video's release, Amore took to social media to express frustration over the timing, noting it was filmed in early 2025 and surfaced shortly after AEW held a tribute show for his late friend, PAC. Maven later explained that the footage had originally been shelved after Amore requested a portion be cut, but was ultimately published due to fan demand for extra content.

stories.title: Jon Moxley and Gabe Kidd tag team match at AEW Grand Slam France
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has officially added a high-profile tag team match to the upcoming AEW Grand Slam France event in Paris, featuring Death Riders members Jon Moxley and Gabe Kidd. The bout was booked following a challenge from the Don Callis Family's Mark Davis and Jake Doyle in the wake of Moxley's recent match against Doyle. Despite some previous tension between Moxley and Kidd, the uneasy alliance will now square off against Davis and Doyle at the Adidas Arena.

stories.title: Bryan Danielson AEW plans following in-ring return
stories.tldr: Bryan Danielson made a surprise in-ring return during a special AEW Dynamite tribute show dedicated to the late PAC. He teamed up with the Death Riders to defeat the Don Callis family, bringing closure to his past rivalry with Jon Moxley. Despite this emotional comeback, backstage reports indicate that Danielson is not returning to full-time action or regular television plans. His appearance was strictly a one-night-only exception made specifically to honor PAC.

stories.title: New police report details regarding PAC's passing
stories.tldr: A newly released police incident report sheds light on the final hours of AEW star PAC, who was found unresponsive in a vehicle near Chicago O Hare International Airport on September 27. Authorities found his phone open to airport directions and answered a call from a woman who confirmed he had planned to grab lunch before a delayed flight to the United Kingdom. Although an initial autopsy has been performed, his official cause of death remains pending further testing while the global wrestling community continues to honor his memory.

stories.title: Chris Jericho says he doesn't have to win ever again in AEW
stories.tldr: During an appearance on TMZ's Inside The Ring podcast, Chris Jericho stated that wins and losses are no longer a priority for him in AEW as he focuses on elevating younger talent. He pointed to past extended programs and matches with stars like MJF, Will Ospreay, and Bandido as examples of how working with him helped launch or solidify their main event status. While he acknowledged that he still needs to win occasionally to keep stories compelling, his primary goal now is delivering great performances and helping emerging wrestlers find their potential.

stories.title: AEW locker room reaction to PAC tribute show
stories.tldr: Following the passing of PAC, AEW recently hosted a heartfelt tribute episode of Dynamite to honor his legacy. Backstage, the emotional atmosphere culminated with the entire locker room sitting and crying together after watching the closing tribute video. Will Ospreay and Ricochet delivered a critically acclaimed and intensely difficult singles match on the card, with Ospreay even dusting off the Black Arrow for the first time in eight years. Reflecting on the heavy night, Mike Bailey and Ospreay both shared insights into the raw emotions and immense physical toll required to properly honor their late friend.

stories.title: Adam Copeland bucket list venue and WWE departure
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently reflected on his decision to leave WWE for AEW, noting that the move allowed him to check off several historic wrestling venues from his career bucket list. Over the past month, the WWE Hall of Famer has wrestled at Arena Mexico, Wembley Stadium, and the Mattamy Athletic Centre, which sits on the historic grounds of Maple Leaf Gardens in his hometown of Toronto. Industry reports indicate that Copeland still has one major venue left on his list: the Tokyo Dome, with speculation pointing toward a possible appearance at Wrestle Kingdom in January 2027. Copeland credited AEW President Tony Khan for fostering an environment that makes these unique career opportunities possible.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett discusses unfinished AEW story with MJF
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett recently discussed his career goals in wrestling, noting an unfinished storyline with MJF and his desire to eventually chase tag or trios gold. He also shared high praise for Bryan Danielson as one of the greatest in-ring storytellers of all time. In addition, Jarrett emotionally recalled his final backstage conversation with Pac at AEW All Out, just a day before the star's sudden and tragic passing.

stories.title: Wheeler Yuta wants AEW World Tag Titles with Death Riders
stories.tldr: Wheeler Yuta recently expressed his desire to pursue the AEW World Tag Team Championships alongside fellow Death Riders associate Daniel Garcia. During an interview with The Wrestling Classic, Yuta highlighted their instant chemistry and shared wrestling philosophies as major reasons to chase tag team gold together. Neither Yuta, Garcia, nor any other member of the Death Riders has ever held the AEW World Tag Team titles. Meanwhile, the current champions, The Young Bucks, are set to defend their titles against Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight at the upcoming AEW WrestleDream pay-per-view.

stories.title: Thekla recalls Jeff Jarrett compliment in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW star Thekla recently discussed her chaotic character and memorable moments during a recent interview. She recalled how veteran Jeff Jarrett praised her unhinged behavior with a humorous compliment following her dramatic return promo at All In in London. Meanwhile, fellow veteran Paul Wight had a much more cautious reaction to her antics at the commentary desk, worrying more about spilled drinks than the danger.

stories.title: AEW babyface turns coming soon ahead of WrestleDream
stories.tldr: As AEW approaches the WrestleDream pay-per-view, fan reactions are pushing several prominent heels toward inevitable babyface turns. The Death Riders are positioned to officially transition into fan favorites following a poignant tribute to the late PAC and an alliance with Bryan Danielson. Meanwhile, crowd support for Tommaso Ciampa and growing hostility toward Mercedes Mone in Thekla's upcoming title chase create ideal conditions for both stars to embrace anti-hero roles.

stories.title: Jacques Rougeau disputes report about AEW backstage incident
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Jacques Rougeau has strongly denied reports that he threw a tantrum backstage at AEW Redemption after a family tribute video was pulled from the broadcast. According to initial reports, the video could not be aired due to unauthorized copyrighted material and AI-generated content discovered at the last minute. However, Rougeau disputed this, stating the video had been approved six weeks prior and that he merely expressed frustration without raising his voice. Ultimately, Rougeau accepted the decision, proceeded with the live segment, and reported having a positive interaction with AEW President Tony Khan afterward.

stories.title: Jim Ross brain procedure and health updates
stories.tldr: AEW announcer Jim Ross is heading back into surgery to address ongoing complications with his brain shunt. Following severe headaches that disrupted his sleep, doctors determined a new procedure was necessary. Additionally, recent medical scans have revealed a concerning spot on his kidney, prompting further testing by his oncology team.

stories.title: Paramount-WBD merger impact on AEW and executive changes
stories.tldr: The upcoming corporate merger will officially close under the Skydance banner on October 6, bringing heavy debt and executive restructuring. TNT Sports CEO Luis Silberwasser is departing, placing AEW under the sports portfolio of incoming executive David Berson. While existing television agreements provide short-term stability, the new leadership faces intense profitability pressures and potential streaming platform consolidation.

stories.title: Tony Khan decisions and changes for AEW PAC tribute show
stories.tldr: Tony Khan made sweeping creative changes to the September 30 episode of Dynamite to ensure it served as a pure tribute to PAC. He completely removed all promotional material and angles for the upcoming pay-per-view and Collision. The original plans for the broadcast were scrapped and delayed to subsequent episodes, forcing the creative team to speed up upcoming storylines as the company prepared for its trip to France.

stories.title: The Rock responds to report about WWE reaction to his AEW praise in PAC tribute
stories.tldr: Dwayne The Rock Johnson has addressed rumors that individuals within WWE were surprised by his public praise of AEW during a video tribute to the late PAC. Following reports that his wording caught some officials off guard, Johnson took to Instagram to clarify his stance. He firmly stated that corporate competition is irrelevant when mourning a member of the wrestling community, emphasizing that humanity and supporting grieving wrestlers matter most to him.

stories.title: Samoa Joe thought his career was over after 2020 concussion
stories.tldr: Samoa Joe recently reflected on a dark period in 2020 when a severe concussion led him to believe his in-ring wrestling career was over. During this time away from the ring, he transitioned to commentary for WWE before experiencing two separate releases due to corporate restructuring. Fortunately, a miraculous turn of events occurred just four hours after his second firing when he received an unexpected call to audition for Peacock's Twisted Metal, ultimately revitalizing his career and leading to his eventual return to professional wrestling with AEW.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett names his AEW Mount Rushmore with Tony Khan at the top
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jeff Jarrett recently revealed his picks for an AEW Mount Rushmore during an appearance on KickOut, naming Chris Jericho, Sting, The Elite, and MJF as the foundational figures of the company. However, the WWE Hall of Famer emphasized that AEW President Tony Khan belongs in an entirely different category altogether. According to Jarrett, Khan is not merely part of the monument, but is instead the mountain itself whose vision made the entire promotion possible.

stories.title: Alex Zayne Not Under AEW/ROH Contract
stories.tldr: Alex Zayne is currently not under a contract with AEW or ROH despite his regular appearances for the promotion. He recently competed at the Ring of Honor television tapings held at WJCT Studios in Jacksonville, Florida. During these tapings, Zayne faced competitors like Adam Priest and teamed up with Mance Warner.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream preview and card updates
stories.tldr: AEW is heading toward its WrestleDream pay-per-view in Orlando with plenty of uncertainty surrounding the match card. While three matches have been partially outlined, including a chaotic eight-man Clockwork Carnage match for the World Championship and title defenses for Mercedes Mone and the Young Bucks, several major champions and qualifiers remain up in the air. Upcoming events like Grand Slam France are set to sort out these pivotal challengers before the October pay-per-view.

stories.title: New addition hinted for AEW Death Riders faction
stories.tldr: The AEW Death Riders faction may soon add a female member to help advance their campaign of violence and elevate a new star's career. Three potential candidates for the Jon Moxley led group include Willow Nightingale, Thekla, and Deonna Purrazzo. Each wrestler offers unique possibilities for character evolution, ranging from gritty rebrands to unexpected alliances and dramatic betrayals.

stories.title: Paul Wight expresses interest in heel turn and working with Darby Allin
stories.tldr: Paul Wight recently expressed a strong desire to turn heel and step into the ring with AEW star Darby Allin. During a virtual signing, Wight praised the incredible athleticism of the current generation of professional wrestlers. He specifically highlighted Allin as an ideal opponent for a brutal matchup that would play on their contrasting styles. Allin is currently holding his third reign as the AEW TNT Champion and preparing for upcoming defenses.

stories.title: WOL: The politics of tribute shows, Death Riders' future & confusing rules
stories.tldr: The latest early edition of the Sunday wrestling audio show hosted by Josh Nason features a heavy emphasis on All Elite Wrestling. The episode addresses the emotional fallout and tribute show following the recent passing of PAC, alongside industry conjecture regarding WWE. Additionally, the show covers Saturday's Collision, breaking down the Death Riders' future, free agents, and an incredibly confusing set of rules announced for the upcoming WrestleDream main event.

stories.title: AEW's FTR explains how they fell in love with tag team wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW stars Cash Wheeler and Dax Harwood of FTR recently shared the origins of their deep passion for tag team wrestling. Wheeler traced his love back to childhood backyard brawls with his brothers and the strategic elements of tag team psychology. Harwood reminisced about playing Saturday Night Slam Masters on the Super Nintendo with his friends, which forged a memorable bond. Together, the decorated duo has gone on to achieve historic success as multi-time champions across both WWE and AEW.

stories.title: AEW's Thunder Rosa reveals conditions to do a Blood & Guts match
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Thunder Rosa recently discussed the strict conditions under which she would agree to compete in another extreme stipulation match like Blood & Guts. While she is well known for her violent encounters, including her famous Lights Out match against Britt Baker, Rosa insists that future hardcore bouts must be driven by deeply meaningful storylines rather than gratuitous violence. She emphasizes that the physical toll is only worth it if the brutality genuinely serves the narrative being told in the ring. Whether she will participate in a potential future women's Blood & Guts match remains to be seen.

stories.title: Maria Kanellis talks abrupt departure from wrestling and future door
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Maria Kanellis reflects on her abrupt departure from AEW at the end of January 2025 after a twenty-year career in the industry. Although she admits it took time to accept leaving without a proper send-off, she has since transitioned into motherhood, event management, running a florist business, and writing a book. While she is currently not involved in wrestling, she leaves the door open for a potential return if the right opportunity arises. She notes she would specifically consider a comeback if it brought her joy or allowed her to work with The Kingdom one more time.

stories.title: Cageside community reflects on memory of PAC
stories.tldr: Following the shocking and sudden passing of professional wrestler Ben PAC Satterley, the wrestling community has been left reeling once again from another tragic loss in the industry. Writers and fans alike expressed their profound grief, noting how rarely PAC broke character, especially recalling his recent emotional breakdown over the loss of Andy The Butcher Williams. In response to the tragedy, community members shared supportive comments and reflections emphasizing the importance of empathy, humanity, and unity over corporate wrestling rivalries. The resulting collection of tributes serves as a therapeutic outlet for fans processing their sorrow together.

stories.title: Young Bucks set to defend tag titles at AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: The newly crowned four-time AEW World Tag Team Champions The Young Bucks will make their first title defense against Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight of the Don Callis Family at AEW WrestleDream. Fletcher and Knight earned their championship opportunity at All Out by defeating Darby Allin and Steven Borden via referee stoppage after Borden suffered a concussion. The challengers hold strong momentum heading into the event, including a prior victory over the champions and potential dual-championship aspirations for Fletcher. Additionally, the WrestleDream card will feature major championship bouts including a Women's World Championship match and a historic Clockwork Carnage Match for the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: Big E reacts to Kofi Kingston & Austin Creed's new career path in AEW
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Big E has expressed his unwavering support for his longtime stablemates Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed following their recent move to AEW. Operating now as The New Level alongside Swerve Strickland, the duo has already captured the AEW World Trios Championships just one month into their run. Big E, who remains under WWE contract as an analyst and ambassador, emphasized that their personal bond transcends any specific company. Meanwhile, Kofi Kingston is already looking ahead to more gold as he prepares to challenge Bandido for the ROH World Championship at Grand Slam France.

stories.title: Chris Jericho reveals how he and Samoa Joe handled Tony Khan creative idea
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho recently shared insights on how he and Samoa Joe handled a creative pitch from AEW president Tony Khan that neither wrestler initially liked. Instead of rejecting the idea outright, Jericho and Joe collaborated to rework the concept into an alternative that satisfied everyone involved. Jericho emphasized that professional wrestlers should offer constructive alternatives rather than flatly refusing a boss, drawing on his extensive experience working with both Khan and Vince McMahon.

stories.title: AEW Rumor Look Back (March 27 – April 3, 2026)
stories.tldr: This weekly rumor review examines various professional wrestling reports from late March and early April 2026 to see which predictions and news items ultimately proved accurate. The retrospective evaluates claims regarding WWE events, WrestleMania 42 plans, talent injuries, and AEW scheduling shifts. Several major stories from outlets like the Wrestling Observer and various insiders are graded on their accuracy over the subsequent months.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland hopes rivalry with Hangman Page goes down as one of wrestling's greatest
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland recently expressed his desire for his intense, multi-year feud with Hangman Page to be remembered as one of the greatest rivalries in professional wrestling history. Speaking in an interview, Strickland highlighted their unique chemistry, emotional vulnerability, and ability to captivate audiences regardless of the match stipulation. Their storied history dates back to 2023 and includes extreme encounters such as home invasions, arson, and a brutal steel cage match at All Out 2024. The two recently crossed paths again in the trios division at AEW All Out 2026, proving that fans remain intensely invested whenever they share the ring.

stories.title: Backstage Reaction To AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Backstage reaction to the 2026 AEW All Out pay-per-view was generally positive due to the strong in-ring content delivered throughout the show. However, the event was heavily overshadowed by a serious injury sustained by Steven Borden during his tag team match, which required him to be stretchered out of the arena and hospitalized. Fortunately, Borden was responsive and received positive test results following the incident. AEW now faces a rapid turnaround as they prepare for their next pay-per-view event, WrestleDream, scheduled for October 17th in Orlando, Florida.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff says AEW TV contract could limit immediate merger changes
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff believes AEW will be insulated from immediate corporate shakeups following the upcoming Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery merger due to Tony Khan having a binding television contract. Unlike Bischoff's time running WCW as an internal Turner employee, the network cannot unilaterally pull strings without potential legal repercussions. Bischoff notes that while minor scheduling flexibility might exist depending on contract terms, Khan's budget and operational status are largely protected until the agreement nears its expiration. Consequently, any early corporate maneuvering will likely happen behind closed doors without direct visibility for AEW leadership.

stories.title: Clockwork Carnage World Championship match announced for AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a brand new multi-man match stipulation called Clockwork Carnage for the upcoming WrestleDream pay-per-view on October 17, 2026, in Orlando, Florida. Will Ospreay will defend his AEW World Championship in this chaotic eight-person contest that combines staggered entrances, eliminations, and a timed scoring period. Aside from Ospreay, the full field of competitors has not yet been revealed, and Ospreay faces previous title commitments including Kazuchika Okada at Grand Slam Paris.

stories.title: Scorpio Sky's AEW contract expiring without new deal signed
stories.tldr: Scorpio Sky's AEW contract is set to expire this month, and he had not signed a new deal as of the recent All Out event. The former inaugural tag team champion and multi-time TNT Champion has seen limited television time recently, working mostly in Ring of Honor and with Top Flight. Other notable AEW contracts, including those of The Acclaimed, are also reportedly unresolved as October begins. Sky has admitted it has been hard not wrestling regularly despite being under contract, leaving his immediate future in professional wrestling uncertain.

stories.title: Jay White sidelined with injury following All Out
stories.tldr: AEW star Jay White is once again sidelined with an injury sustained following the All Out pay-per-view event. Announcer Tony Schiavone revealed the news on the October 3, 2026 episode of Collision, noting that White is expected to miss one to two months of action. This latest setback is particularly frustrating given his extensive history of injuries throughout 2024 and 2025, which included a broken hand and shoulder surgery. Since returning to the ring in July 2026, the leader of the Bang Bang Gang has competed in ten matches before facing this new recovery period.

stories.title: Matches added to AEW Grand Slam France
stories.tldr: AEW has loaded the card for its historic first-ever live event in France, AEW Grand Slam France, taking place at the Adidas Arena in Paris with Dynamite and Collision tapings. Four new matches have been added to the event, including high-stakes championship defenses and a crucial tournament qualifier. Samoa Joe and Jack Perry will battle in a Clockwork Carnage qualifier for a World title match at WrestleDream, while several champions put their gold on the line.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar inducted into University of Minnesota M Club Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Former WWE and UFC champion Brock Lesnar was officially inducted into the University of Minnesota M Club Hall of Fame during a weekend ceremony in Minneapolis. The honor comes just two months after Lesnar announced his retirement from professional wrestling following his SummerSlam match against Oba Femi. Inducted alongside nine other former Golden Gophers athletes, Lesnar was celebrated for his stellar amateur career which included a 2000 NCAA heavyweight championship. Longtime friend and former colleague Shelton Benjamin was among those in attendance to support him.

stories.title: Matt Hardy talks Tony Khan and Being The Elite
stories.tldr: During a recent episode of his podcast, wrestling veteran Matt Hardy revealed that AEW President Tony Khan was not always happy with Being The Elite or certain actions by The Young Bucks. Hardy defended the influential web series, emphasizing that professional wrestling needs a balance of serious vibes, fun, and comedy. He also praised The Young Bucks for breaking barriers, helping start AEW, and using BTE to enhance storytelling.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer notes AEW star responsible for NJPW relationship
stories.tldr: According to Dave Meltzer on Wrestling Observer Radio, Jon Moxley is the key figure responsible for bridging the gap to establish the working relationship between AEW and New Japan Pro Wrestling. Initially, NJPW management held hard feelings over The Elite leaving in 2019 and former president Harold Meij saw no benefit in partnering with AEW. Moxley changed the landscape during the pandemic by holding the IWGP United States Championship while signed with AEW, which eventually led to crossover appearances like KENTA arriving in AEW.

stories.title: AEW 2026 PPV schedule and list
stories.tldr: The official All Elite Wrestling pay-per-view schedule for late 2026 highlights several major events taking place across North America. Fans can mark their calendars for WrestleDream in October, Full Gear in November, and Worlds End in December. These blockbuster events will be accessible through a wide variety of digital streaming platforms as well as traditional cable and satellite providers. As the year progresses, the broader event calendar remains subject to further updates and additions.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live discusses Jon Moxley's leadership
stories.tldr: On this episode of Wrestling Observer Live, host Jim Valley broadcasts from the road in Tennessee while reflecting on AEW's emotional tribute to the late PAC. Valley highlights how Jon Moxley stood out during the tribute episodes through his inspired promos, matches, and crucial veteran leadership, cementing his status as one of the most important signings in AEW history. The show also pays tribute to the late Memphis wrestling legend Bill Dundee, remembering his unconventional style, giant talent, and massive success in the sport alongside other territory greats like Jerry Lawler and Dutch Mantel.

stories.title: First match revealed for Chris Jericho's Rock N Wrestling Rager at Sea
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho has announced the first official match for his upcoming Rock N Wrestling Rager at Sea, featuring a historic six-man tag team main event. Jericho will team up with Matt Hardy and Jeff Hardy to face the trio of Blake Christian, Jay Lethal, and Nick Wayne on November 11. This bout marks the very first time Jericho and the Hardys will wrestle as a trio, drawing on matches that date back years. Additionally, the cruise will host a live broadcast of AEW Collision on Saturday, November 7, kicking off an exciting card for the high-seas event.

stories.title: AEW trios star praises Austin Creed and Kofi as future Hall of Famers
stories.tldr: The AEW trios division has heated up significantly following the debut of Kofi and Austin Creed alongside Swerve Strickland. During a recent interview, The Demand star Bishop Kaun praised the former WWE standouts as future Hall of Famers. Kaun shared his deep admiration for their careers, including Kofi's historic world championship win and Creed's consistent in-ring excellence.

stories.title: AEW's Zayda Steel lists wrestler inspirations growing up
stories.tldr: AEW and Ring of Honor talent Zayda Steel recently shared her childhood wrestling inspirations during a virtual signing with Captain's Corner. She named major WWE stars like AJ Lee, the Four Horsewomen, and Kelly Kelly, alongside male standouts such as The Undertaker and The Boogeyman. This past August, Steel experienced a full-circle moment when she shared the ring with Four Horsewomen member Mercedes Mone on AEW Collision.

stories.title: Efforts underway to build statue of PAC in Newcastle
stories.tldr: Efforts are currently underway to erect a permanent statue honoring the late PAC in his hometown of Newcastle. Former wrestling colleague Big Damo revealed that discussions and permission-seeking are taking place to create the monument to celebrate the beloved star and passionate soccer fan. The wrestling community continues to mourn the profound loss of the influential performer, whose sudden passing has deeply devastated friends and peers alike.

stories.title: Marina Shafir confirmed for MyAEW PPV title match
stories.tldr: AEW star and Death Riders member Marina Shafir has been officially confirmed to challenge for the Pro Wrestling EVE International Championship in November. The title match was issued by reigning champion Miyu Yamashita after a successful defense at TJPW Wrestle Princess VII, following a previous attack by Shafir during All In weekend. The showdown will take place at Pro Wrestling EVE Elite Encounters 2 in Wolverhampton, England, and will be broadcast live via pay-per-view and YouTube.

stories.title: Jim Ross gives thoughts on Tommy End
stories.tldr: Wrestling Hall of Famer Jim Ross recently shared his perspective on Tommy End following the wrestler's second departure from WWE after WrestleMania 42. Ross praised End's immense in-ring talent and unique versatility, expressing confidence that the free agent will easily secure future employment. However, Ross cautioned End to leave behind past grievances and focus forward rather than dwelling on industry frustrations. Potential landing spots were also discussed on the podcast, including TNA Wrestling, though Ross admitted he is unfamiliar with their programming.

stories.title: AEW Collision ticket sales update for October 3
stories.tldr: AEW Collision is broadcasting live tonight from the Truist Arena in Highland Heights, Kentucky, with nearly two thousand tickets distributed so far. While current numbers sit slightly below the promotion's year to date average of 2,141 tickets per event, late walk-up sales could help close the gap. The live broadcast features a strong lineup of matches, highlighted by a continental title eliminator between Jon Moxley and Jake Doyle. Fans can tune in to watch the action unfold live on TNT and HBO Max.

stories.title: MJF reflects on lessons from first AEW World Championship reign
stories.tldr: Maxwell Jacob Friedman recently reflected on the key lessons he learned during his historic 406-day AEW World Championship reign. He pointed to Adam Cole's betrayal and his own vulnerability with the fans as massive mistakes that taught him never to trust anyone in the wrestling business again. Furthermore, MJF stated that he no longer cares if fans like him and explained that he uses online negativity as fuel for his training.

stories.title: Steven Borden explains decision to pursue professional wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW star Steven Borden recently shared that he decided to pursue professional wrestling after experiencing his legendary father Sting's retirement match at the 2024 Revolution pay-per-view. Starting his training and having his first match in his early thirties, Borden wanted to avoid the regret of the what if question as he watched his father ride off into the sunset. Following memorable appearances alongside his brother Garrett where they dressed in iconic Sting personas and got physical with The Young Bucks, Steven has since made his own in-ring debut at All Out alongside Darby Allin.

stories.title: AEW Collision October 3 live coverage and card updates
stories.tldr: The latest episode of AEW Collision featured Kofi defeating Lee Moriarty in his milestone AEW singles debut, alongside matches involving Jon Moxley, The Conglomeration, and the Death Riders. Following the broadcast, major match cards and qualifiers were announced for upcoming events like WrestleDream and Grand Slam France. Additionally, updates revealed an injury setback for Jay White and additional pre-show bouts held in Kentucky.

stories.title: AEW Collision Live Broadcast from Chris Jericho Cruise
stories.tldr: For the first time in company history, AEW will broadcast an episode of Saturday night flagship show AEW Collision live from Chris Jericho's upcoming Rock 'N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise. Set for November 7, 2026, while the ship is docked in Miami, Florida, this marks AEW's first live television broadcast from the cruise since a pre-taped Dynamite aired in 2020. Chris Jericho revealed that overcoming massive logistical hurdles like satellite connections and generators made the monumental event possible, which coincides with the same day as WWE Crown Jewel.

stories.title: AEW Collision October 3 Matches Announced
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has announced a loaded lineup for the upcoming episode of AEW Collision airing live coast to coast on TNT and HBO Max from Kentucky. The card is highlighted by Kofi making his highly anticipated AEW singles debut against ROH Pure Champion Lee Moriarty. Fans will also see Julia Hart battle Queen Aminata and Jon Moxley face Jake Doyle in an AEW Continental Title Eliminator match.

stories.title: David Finlay on Choosing AEW Over WWE NXT
stories.tldr: David Finlay recently explained on Chris Jericho's podcast why he chose to sign with AEW instead of WWE NXT. He cited better pay, a more favorable schedule, and the presence of his friends in AEW as major factors in his decision. Despite having family connections in NXT, Finlay felt he would have struggled to readjust to the level of humility required by WWE after already proving himself in the industry. He currently performs in AEW as part of The Dogs alongside Clark Connors and Gabe Kidd.

stories.title: Toni Storm AEW Mystery
stories.tldr: The sudden disappearance of Timeless Toni Storm from All Elite Wrestling in March 2026 was framed as a whodunnit mystery following a backstage attack angle on Dynamite. Crafted largely by RJ City on short notice, the crime scene featured numerous Easter eggs and clues pointing to various members of the roster. AEW even released merchandise, including a t-shirt and an art print poster, featuring an extensive list of potential suspects. While Storm has no official return date set, the unresolved storyline leaves the door wide open for her eventual comeback.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Favorite Tag Team Partner
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho recently revealed during an interview that Paul Wight, formerly known as the Big Show, is his all-time favorite tag team partner due to their incredible chemistry in and out of the ring. The two legendary wrestlers previously formed the dominant WWE tag team known as Jeri-Show back in 2009. Jericho also discussed Wight's current commentary work in AEW, fondly recalling a recent comedic moment where he sat on Wight's lap during a match in Las Vegas.

stories.title: AEW Next Champions Predictions
stories.tldr: Following recent events like All Out 2026, analysts have released a comprehensive set of predictions for every championship in All Elite Wrestling. The projected title changes feature major stars capturing gold, ranging from established veterans to rising talents across the companys vast roster. Notable predicted shifts include Thekla challenging Mercedes Mone for the Womens World Championship and Ilja Dragunov stepping up for the TNT Championship. Fans can expect significant shifts in the landscape of AEW as these storylines develop in the coming months.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam France Global Start Times
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling is heading to France for the very first time on October 6, 2026, with AEW Grand Slam France emanating from the 8,000-capacity Adidas Arena. The historic event will feature a double taping for both Dynamite and Collision, with the latter scheduled to air later on Saturday night. Even though the action kicks off locally at around 6pm in Europe, Dynamite will maintain its usual start time for viewers in the United States. Fans across the globe can now plan their viewing schedules using the newly released international start times.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite PAC Tribute Show Viewership and Backstage Reactions
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of Benjamin Satterley, known to fans as PAC, the wrestling world continued to honor his memory through emotional tributes and soaring television ratings. AEW's September 30 tribute episode drew a massive 899,000 viewers, while promotions like Dragon Gate also held dedicated memorial ceremonies. Backstage details have since emerged regarding last-minute talent arrivals, high-risk emotional tributes, and the wider industry reaction to his sudden loss.

stories.title: AEW Women's Division Star Banged Up After All Out
stories.tldr: AEW women's tag team champion Jamie Hayter emerged from her brutal Chicago street fight at All Out 2026 quite worse for wear. Tony Schiavone reported that Hayter admitted to being banged up following the violent encounter involving barbed wire and thumbtacks. None of the participants from the grueling title match competed on the subsequent episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Will Ospreay United Empire Name in AEW
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay secured the United Empire trademark to smoothly transition his dominant faction into AEW without the ownership hurdles that plagued groups like Bullet Club. The American branch has since expanded with new additions like Mike Bailey and closer alignment with Andrade El Idolo. Meanwhile, Ospreay continues to work with New Japan, where he will return in October to defend the NEVER Openweight Six-Man Tag Team Championships.

stories.title: Jim Cornette on Steven Borden Injury at AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Jim Cornette recently shared his thoughts on the scary botch that led to Steven Borden's injury at AEW All Out. According to Cornette, Borden and Kevin Knight botched a mid-air collision spot because of a timing and technique mismatch on the top rope. While Cornette is glad Borden is recovering well and avoiding long-term symptoms, he believes the young star is still too inexperienced for major promotion pressure.

stories.title: Sheamus becomes free agent with report of AEW interest
stories.tldr: Former WWE champion Sheamus has officially become a free agent following the expiration of his contract, stemming from his departure earlier this year after declining a restructured deal with a pay cut. Reports indicate that management is expected to pursue the veteran star, with a handful of wrestlers in the locker room also supporting the idea of him joining the promotion. While there are no current discussions, a formal deal, or a confirmed timeline for his debut, his arrival could open the door for major feuds or a run in the tag team division alongside Claudio Castagnoli.

stories.title: Will Ospreay reflects on hitting PAC's Black Arrow on tribute AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: During a special AEW Dynamite tribute episode dedicated to the late PAC, Will Ospreay defeated Ricochet by executing PAC's signature Black Arrow finisher. Ospreay revealed he arrived at the arena early and spent hours practicing the high-flying maneuver, which he had not performed in eight years. The emotional moment resonated deeply with fans, backstage talent, and fellow wrestlers, while commentator Tony Schiavone later suggested the iconic finishing move should now be retired out of respect.

stories.title: Jim Ross details severe post-brain surgery headaches
stories.tldr: AEW commentator Jim Ross provided a candid health update on his podcast, revealing that he is dealing with severe, debilitating headaches following brain surgery earlier this year. The 74-year-old WWE Hall of Famer explained that a shunt placed to drain excess fluid has proven problematic, waking him up in the middle of the night despite already being adjusted three times. Ross has a CT scan and a follow-up appointment with his neurosurgeon scheduled to address the issue, alongside separate checks for a spot on his kidney. Despite these ongoing health struggles and a string of recent injuries from balance-related falls, Ross remains eager to return to the AEW commentary booth and expresses deep gratitude for his career in professional wrestling.

stories.title: Bayley shares emotional statement following AEW Dynamite tribute to PAC
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of AEW star PAC at the age of 40, AEW dedicated a touching tribute episode of Dynamite to the late wrestler. WWE star Bayley, who previously honored PAC with an armband on WWE Raw, took to social media to share an emotional statement about the event. She praised professional wrestling's unique ability to provide both an escape for fans and a powerful way to honor loved ones. The special broadcast featured emotional tributes, eulogies from the roster, and five dedicated matches involving top talent across the company.

stories.title: Chris Hero discusses origin and pronunciation of PAC's ring name
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of star wrestler PAC at the age of 40, his longtime friend and colleague Chris Hero shared the heartfelt origin and correct pronunciation of his famous ring name. Hero revealed on social media that the name is pronounced pack rather than pock, stemming from a childhood nickname given to him by his father referencing Six Pack Ben Satterley. While acknowledging that many fans and peers naturally mispronounced it due to influences like 2Pac and X-Pac, Hero noted that PAC himself was too humble to correct anyone.

stories.title: Steve Maclin teases potential move to AEW and targeting top faction
stories.tldr: Former TNA star and current free agent Steve Maclin has expressed strong interest in joining AEW and named Darby Allin as his number one desired opponent due to his physical style and recent work ethic. Maclin also pointed to his close friendship with Josh Alexander and teased potential involvement with the Don Callis Family. Additionally, Maclin recently discussed the creative frustrations that ultimately led to his departure from TNA while promoting an upcoming match against Adam Copeland.

stories.title: TNA wrestler Mila Moore set for MyAEW PPV debut with EVE
stories.tldr: TNA star and Order 4 Secretary of Strategic Affairs Mila Moore is scheduled to make her promotional debut for Pro Wrestling EVE this Friday. She will face UK standout Chantal Jordan at the Global Thunder Queens Attack event in London, England. The card will broadcast live on MyAEW PPV and YouTube, featuring a star-studded lineup and the debut of Will Ospreay's innovative Clockwork Carnage match.

stories.title: Finn Balor and Drew McIntyre honor the late PAC
stories.tldr: Following the shocking death of professional wrestler Pac, also known as Ben Satterley, friends and former colleagues continue to share heartfelt memories. While AEW recently hosted a dedicated tribute episode, WWE stars Finn Balor and Drew McIntyre took to social media to honor their late peer. Both wrestlers shared personal reflections, photos, and emotional messages celebrating Pac's profound impact on the wrestling industry.

stories.title: Corey Graves acknowledges death of PAC during WWE x AAA broadcast
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of Ben Satterley, widely known as PAC and formerly WWE star Adrian Neville, the wrestling community came together to honor his memory. During the taped WWE and AAA Worlds Collide broadcast, announcer Corey Graves delivered a heartfelt on-air tribute alongside JBL, reflecting on their past as NXT tag team partners. Tributes also poured in across the industry from WWE and AEW stars alike, including memorial graphics, social media posts, specialized ring gear, and dedicated television tributes.

stories.title: Reason behind MJF missing the PAC tribute episode of AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: MJF was notably absent from the September 30 AEW Dynamite episode, which served as an emotional tribute show for PAC. Fans questioned why one of the company's biggest stars did not make an appearance to pay his respects. According to wrestling insider Mike Johnson, keeping MJF off the show was a deliberate creative choice that aligned with his villainous on-screen persona. Instead of disrupting his current absence since All In for a one-off appearance, AEW opted to save his return for the right storyline moment.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett says Kazuchika Okada needed character evolution for American TV
stories.tldr: AEW performer and veteran Jeff Jarrett recently discussed Kazuchika Okada on his My World podcast, explaining that the wrestling legend had to evolve his on-screen character to succeed on American television. While acknowledging Okada's historic success and incredible in-ring style in Japan, Jarrett noted that US audiences require deeper character work and personality extensions. He specifically praised Okada's recent heel antics, such as flipping off fans during matches, for adding Hollywood depth to his persona.

stories.title: Jon Moxley addresses crowd following PAC tribute Dynamite
stories.tldr: Following the emotional AEW Dynamite tribute to the late PAC, Jon Moxley delivered a powerful off-air speech sharing a favorite memory and life lesson from his friend. Moxley recalled PAC describing their group as professionals who give a shit, turning the sentiment into broader advice about approaching everyday life with purpose. Meanwhile, returning star Wardlow took to social media to reflect on his bittersweet comeback night amidst the tragedy.

stories.title: AEW releases extended online tribute videos for PAC
stories.tldr: Following the recent passing of Benjamin Satterley, known as PAC, AEW dedicated a recent episode of Dynamite to his memory with numerous emotional tributes. Because so many wrestlers wanted to share their memories but could not fit into the live broadcast, the company released an extended nearly 50-minute video on YouTube. The footage features heartfelt messages from colleagues like Bryan Danielson, The Young Bucks, and Chris Jericho, who shared stories about his professionalism, friendship, and history together. Additionally, stars like Kenny Omega and Mercedes Mone made special travel and appearance accommodations to be at the tribute show.

stories.title: Will Ospreay's business deals and career outside WWE
stories.tldr: Building on his recent Assassin's Creed-themed entrance at AEW All Out, Will Ospreay has reflected on his unique three-year corporate partnership with the gaming franchise that sets him apart from typical WWE brand deals. Unlike standard event or match sponsorships, this collaboration is tied directly to Ospreay's personal identity and on-screen persona. Looking ahead, the AEW star has expressed ambitions to deepen the relationship by securing a video game cameo, in-game DLC gear, or even an acting role in a live-action adaptation.

stories.title: Status and future of United Empire faction in AEW
stories.tldr: Building on his recent trademark acquisition, Will Ospreay has officially launched an American chapter of the United Empire in AEW. The faction's growing lineup now features Andrade El Idolo, Mike Bailey, Alex Windsor, and Jamie Hayter. While this rapid expansion has caused some friction with Japan-based members like Callum Newman, Ospreay is already eyeing additional AEW stars to further strengthen his ranks.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff advises Tony Khan on pitching long-term plans to network executives
stories.tldr: Expanding on his recent advice regarding television negotiations, Eric Bischoff detailed on his 83 Weeks podcast that Tony Khan should specifically present a credible three-year growth plan to any new network management. Bischoff emphasized that this strategy must look beyond satisfying the core internet wrestling audience and focus heavily on mainstream storytelling. He also advised Khan to proactively request meetings and seek help from experienced wrestling minds to structure the pitch before any potential issues arise.

stories.title: Bryan Danielson’s next match in AEW – Potential opponents for the former world champion following his return on the Dynamite: A Tribute to PAC show
stories.tldr: Following his shocking in-ring return on a special PAC tribute episode of AEW Dynamite, Bryan Danielson is open to sporadic special appearances despite being retired from full-time competition. During the broadcast, he teamed with the Death Riders and officially reconciled with Jon Moxley. Moving forward, several intriguing potential opponents and match concepts have emerged for the former world champion should he step back into the ring. These future possibilities include a clash with his wrestling soulmate Hangman Adam Page, a friendly rematch against Moxley, or a surprise entry in a Casino Gauntlet match.
